name: Mirador de los Cóndores and Las Águilas
region: Los Glaciares National Park, north sector
why: The walk for the afternoon you arrive: El Chaltén from above, Fitz Roy at sunset, condors on the cliff.
water: None on the way: carry a bottle.
dangers: Open to the wind on both lookouts.

points.name: Los Glaciares visitor centre, El Chaltén
points.note: The path leaves from behind the ranger station.

points.name: Mirador de los Cóndores
points.note: 20-30 minutes up: the village under Fitz Roy. Condors nest on the cliff.

points.name: Mirador de las Águilas
points.note: 30 minutes more over open steppe: Lago Viedma and its glacier to the south.
